529-1251-3197-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1479-2841-6754-8100.easyPrerequisites:
(optional)You control an Elf or have an Elf card in hand. Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Elven Passage.
1479-2841-6754-8100.description:
Fetch a land using Elven Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Eusocial Engineering and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1365-2608-6495-6582.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Derevi and Aerith persist until end of turn.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Derevi.
When Derevi dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Aerith.
When Aerith dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve Aerith's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Aerith trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each legendary creature you control, thus removing the -1/-1 counters from Aerith and Derevi.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
1365-2608-6495-6582.notes:
The combo does not put +1/+1 counters on Derevi or Aerith, but does on any other legendary creature(s) you control.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

222-527-4247-4885.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4247-4885.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2111-3545-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

301-5805-7859.easyPrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
301-5805-7859.description:
Activate Goblin Chirurgeon by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve the Goblin Chirurgeon ability.
Repeat.

104-4186-6830-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-4186-6830-7810.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

489-1020-2866-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

628-2292-7214.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Glen Elendra Guardian.
When Glen Elendra Guardian dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

11-5195-6526-7202.description:
Cast Flamehold Grappler by paying {U}{R}{W}.
When Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast this turn.
Cast Kindle the Inner Flame by paying its mana cost, targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Flamehold Grappler and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Flamehold Grappler trigger, copying Kindle the Inner Flame, with the copy targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Kindle the Inner Flame, creating a token copy of Flamehold Grappler.
When the token Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast this turn.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Kindle the Inner Flame
Flamehold Grappler and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Flamehold Grappler trigger, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand and creating a copy of Narset's Reversal targeting Kindle the Inner Flame.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy, returning Kindle the Inner Flame to your hand and creating a copy of Kindle the Inner Flame targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Kindle the Inner Flame copy, creating a token copy of Flamehold Grappler.
When the token Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast.
Activate up to four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding enough mana to cast Kindle the Inner Flame.
Repeat from step 3.

3169-4046-4659-7070.description:
Activate Outrider en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Outrider en-Kor.
Cast Outrider en-Kor from exile by paying {2}.
When Outrider en-Kor enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2366-3688-4785-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3688-4785-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

232-1235-4863-5940.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Return the Favor by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Revolutionist.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Revolutionist with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Revolutionist tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Return the Favor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-2043-6311-6965.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

2558-2981-3490-5231-6701.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Repeat.
2558-2981-3490-5231-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel. If desired, you can sacrifice the Servos as well.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

2743-2959-6669.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Heat Shimmer
2743-2959-6669.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase. Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, copying Heat Shimmer twice, with the copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Heat Shimmers, copying Biovisionary three times.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

4775-5256-6553.easyPrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
4775-5256-6553.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2468-2751-4276.notablePrerequisites: Artifacts you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
2468-2751-4276.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate any number of artifacts you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Turnabout without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Turnabout, untapping all artifacts you xontrol.
Repeat from step 2.

1737-2707-4377-6504.manaNeeded: {1} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
1737-2707-4377-6504.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Conjurer's Bauble.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate the Conjurer's Bauble token by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Walk the Aeons onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Walk the Aeons from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each turn.

509-2904-3263-6499.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax if applicable
509-2904-3263-6499.notablePrerequisites:
The top card of your library has a higher mana value than the top cards of each opponent's library.
You have a way to choose one or more targets, as well as additional legal targets for that spell or ability.
509-2904-3263-6499.description:
Cast Idris either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Psychic Battle until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Choose any number of targets by any method.
Idris triggers, causing each player to reveal the top card of their library and changing the target(s) of the spell or ability to Cephalid Illusionist.
Cephalid Illusionist and Idris trigger.
Resolve the Cephalid Illusionist trigger, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing each player to reveal the top card of their library and changing the target(s) of the spell or ability to any other target.
Repeat from step 4.

719-1486-4091.notablePrerequisites:
Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
Xenograft on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
719-1486-4091.description:
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

372-5895-5913.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Splash Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-5895-5913.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Pinnacle Monk and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Pinnacle Monk trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Splash Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Pinnacle Monk and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

240-526-2511.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Egg creature tokens.
240-526-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing an Egg.
When the Egg dies, Atla Palani triggers, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, if it has power 4 or greater, Life Finds a Way triggers, creating a copy of an Egg token you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
240-526-2511.notes: This combo will only fetch every creature in your library if all creatures have power 4 or greater. You may use additional Egg tokens to grab as many creatures as possible.

2018-3532-5078-5231.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library from the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing itself, adding {R}.
When Thermopod dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Thermopod from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing the flying counter from Thermopod.
Repeat.

304-1766-1978.description:
Animate Thran Dynamo using Tough Cookie.
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Thran Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

549-2047-2253.description:
Cast Army of the Damned by paying {5}{B}{B}{B}, creating thirteen 2/2 Zombie creature tokens that are artifacts due to Mycosynth Lattice.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to, and causing you to win the game.

813-3047-4050.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying {B}, targeting Scholar of the Ages.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding {B}.
Scholar of the Ages triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, returning Feign Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1812-2034-3707-4893-5140.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tithe Taker to add {C}{C}.
Tithe Taker triggers, creating 1/1 white and black Spirit token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit token to add {C}{C}.
Activate Prismite by paying {1} to add {B}.
Activate Kenrith by paying {2}{B} to return Tithe Taker from your graveyard to battlefield.
Repeat.

1021-2440-5115-5321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Squirrel.
1021-2440-5115-5321.description:
Activate Squirrel Wrangler by paying {1}{G} and sacrificing Drownyard Temple, creating two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Both Squirrel tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes twice.
Resolve both Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C}{C} for each Squirrel on the battlefield.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

386-1089-1525-4298.notablePrerequisites:
Glistening Oil and Curiosity attached to Borborygmos.
You have a land card in hand.
You have at least eleven lands between your hand and library.
386-1089-1525-4298.description:
Activate Borborygmos by discarding a land, dealing three infect damage to an opponent.
Curiosity triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand and put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
